verdicts.claim: Concepts opened a roughly 440-square-metre, three-floor flagship at 18 Newbury Street in April 2026.
verdicts.note: Wrong year. The 4,700-square-foot, three-floor flagship at 18 Newbury Street opened to the public on Oct 24, 2020, ahead of the brand's 25th anniversary. Fixed the summary, insight, place, district and door text.

verdicts.claim: Concepts opened a three-floor Boston flagship at 18 Newbury Street in April 2026.
verdicts.note: Same error. Changed it to October 2020 in the insight and the place entry. Dropped the source that gave the 2026 date and added the 2020 opening release.

verdicts.claim: A new Concepts flagship opened at 18 Newbury Street in 2026.
verdicts.note: Changed it to October 2020 in the insight, the place and the people entry. The Sneaker Freaker source already listed describes that 2020 opening.

verdicts.claim: Partners list: Concepts 'opened its 18 Newbury St flagship in April 2026'.
verdicts.note: Editor: change it to 'opened its 18 Newbury St flagship in October 2020'. The partnership advice still stands.

verdicts.claim: Boston's minority owner has a pending deal for the Connecticut Sun, which could move a WNBA team to Boston.
verdicts.note: Outdated. The WNBA blocked Steve Pagliuca's $325M Boston bid. The WNBA and NBA approved Tilman Fertitta's $300M purchase and a 2027 move to Houston. Fixed the summary, insight, watchout and verify item.

verdicts.claim: Boston gave Brown a key to the city at a Boston Common sendoff on Aug. 31.
verdicts.note: The 741 Frequency Fest on Boston Common was Sunday, Aug 30. State Rep. Christopher Worrell presented the key, and Mayor Wu gave him a 'Jaylen Brown Way' sign. Text and source fixed.

verdicts.claim: Top insight: 'Boston threw him an Aug 31 sendoff on Boston Common.'
verdicts.note: Editor: change the date to Aug 30. The event was organized by Brown's 741 Performance brand with the city.

verdicts.claim: The Knicks are defending champions and signed Mitchell Robinson away.
verdicts.note: The direction was reversed. Boston signed Robinson away from the Knicks. Changed the text to 'lost Mitchell Robinson to Boston in free agency'.

verdicts.claim: Specter reaction: SI called it mostly hideous, ClutchPoints quoted harsh fan posts, and Yahoo Sports called the Celtics reaction mixed.
verdicts.note: Confirmed SI's 'mostly hideous' line. No ClutchPoints piece could be found, and the Yahoo-cited coverage reported widespread criticism, not a mixed reaction. Rewrote the line to match.

verdicts.claim: Boston Legacy FC's permanent home, the renovated White Stadium, is slated for 2027.
verdicts.note: On Aug 27, 2026 the club announced it will play 2027 at Centreville Bank Stadium in Pawtucket and move into White Stadium in 2028. Fixed the summary, insight, product hook and verify item.

verdicts.claim: Legacy debuted in 2026 at Gillette Stadium, with some matches at Centreville Bank Stadium in Pawtucket.
verdicts.note: Gillette was the primary 2026 venue, with select home matches in Pawtucket.

verdicts.claim: In September 2026 the Celtics and the local Portuguese-American community unveiled a custom Queta court in Cambridge.
verdicts.note: Queta and the Portuguese company Hoopers opened the renovated court at Cambridge's King Open School on Sept 12, 2026. It was backed by the city and the Portuguese consulate, and no Celtics team role was reported. Text fixed.

verdicts.claim: Sullivan's Castle Island reopened for its 75th season on February 27, 2026.
verdicts.note: Coverage says it opened on a Saturday, after a nor'easter. Feb 27, 2026 was a Friday, and the stand had announced Feb 28. Changed it to Saturday, Feb 28 in food.json (3 places) and culture.json.

verdicts.claim: The Celtics open at Detroit on Oct 20 at 3 p.m. ET, then host the Knicks at TD Garden on Friday, Oct 23.
verdicts.note: NBC Sports Boston lists the Oct 23 home opener at 7 p.m. ET and the 3 p.m. Tuesday opener at Detroit. It is Robinson's first game against his old team.

verdicts.claim: Paul George wears No. 13 in Boston, and Brad Stevens said retiring Brown's No. 7 is likely.
verdicts.note: The team posted George in No. 13, and Bleacher Report quotes Stevens saying Brown's number will likely be retired.

verdicts.claim: Luke Murray was hired at Boston College in 2026 after five years under Dan Hurley at UConn.
verdicts.note: BC hired him in late March 2026 to replace the fired Earl Grant. It is his first head-coaching job.

verdicts.claim: Club Cafe's founder, Frank Ribaudo, died in July 2026.
verdicts.note: He died at 81 in July 2026. He helped open Club Cafe in 1983, and the venue still operates.

verdicts.claim: Converse faced 2026 layoff and sale reports.
verdicts.note: Bloomberg reported deep Converse job cuts after a roughly 30% revenue drop. Sale talk is analyst speculation, not a Nike announcement. No cuts specific to Lovejoy Wharf were found, so the watchout stays.

verdicts.claim: Madrugada, Nan James's Roxbury label, ran a Downtown Crossing pop-up in 2026 and plans a Columbus Avenue storefront with the lease pending.
verdicts.note: Axios reported this in September 2026. No signed lease or opening was found after that.

verdicts.claim: The official ProShop is at 84 Causeway Street in The Hub on Causeway, at street level by the TD Garden entrance.
verdicts.note: The address and location are confirmed. The 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. non-game-day hours were not found in any source, so check them before a launch.

verdicts.claim: Nike Boston is at 200 Newbury Street, a two-story door that reopened in 2014, and its page shows an 'Opening Soon' banner.
verdicts.note: Nike's page lists 200 Newbury St with hours and an undated 'Opening Soon' banner. A Nike By You event ran there in April 2026, so the store looks open. The existing watchout to confirm before a launch stays.

verdicts.claim: There is no Boston Calling in 2026, and it returns June 4-6, 2027 at the Harvard Athletic Complex.
verdicts.note: This was announced in June 2025, and no later change was found.

verdicts.claim: Concepts runs a 4,700-square-foot flagship on Newbury Street.
verdicts.note: The size matches the 2020 opening coverage. No date change was needed in uniform.json.

verdicts.claim: Specter uniforms were unveiled for eight historic franchises, the Celtics included.
verdicts.note: The eight franchises are the Celtics, Hawks, Kings, Knicks, Lakers, Pistons, Warriors and 76ers. Which games they will be worn in is still unpublished.

verdicts.claim: Opportunity 'where': Nike Boston, 200 Newbury St (once confirmed open).
verdicts.note: No 2026 closure or reopening news was found. Nike's listing is live and the store hosted an April 2026 event. Keep the hedge.

verdicts.claim: Brown returns to TD Garden for an Oct 10 preseason game and on Jan 21, 2027.
verdicts.note: This matches the verified current facts and the schedule coverage.

verdicts.claim: Queta is on a four-year, $56M extension and wears No. 88.
verdicts.note: The Globe confirms the July extension and the No. 88 painted on the court.

verdicts.claim: The Brown farewell included Mayor Wu and a street sign.
verdicts.note: Wu presented a 'Jaylen Brown Way' sign. Lil Jon, Lil Baby and A$AP Ferg performed. The trade happened on July 1.

verdicts.claim: The Sun play part of their 2026 schedule in Boston.
verdicts.note: One 2026 Sun home game was set for TD Garden before the move to Houston. It is a one-off, not a Boston team.

verdicts.claim: The Greenway's 2026 Dewey Square mural is by Rixy, and Ekua Holmes has the 2027 wall.
verdicts.note: Not re-searched within the budget. The dossier's Beacon Hill Times and Massachusetts 250 sources cover the 2026 mural. Confirm the 2027 Holmes commission with the Conservancy.

summary: The live refresh holds up on the team facts: the schedule, the Oct 23 Knicks home opener, George's No. 13, the Queta extension and the BC coach all check out. The biggest error ran through four dossiers and the brief: Concepts' 18 Newbury Street flagship opened in October 2020, not April 2026. Other fixes: the Connecticut Sun story was stale (the team is going to Houston, not Boston), Legacy FC's White Stadium move slipped to 2028, the Brown sendoff was Aug 30 and the key came from a state rep, a reversed Mitchell Robinson line, an overstated Celtics role in the Queta court and the Castle Island date. Two strategy lines need the editor (the Concepts date and the Aug 31 sendoff). The Nike Boston status and the ProShop hours remain unconfirmed.
